prs.title: test: cover SIZE kind=8 after the earlier fix
prs.diff:
+RUN(NAME size_kind_guard LABELS gfortran llvm)
+program size_kind_guard
+  implicit none
+  integer :: a(5)
+  a = 0
+  call check(size(a, 1, kind=8))
+contains
+  subroutine check(n)
+    integer(8), intent(in) :: n
+    if (n /= 5_8) error stop
+  end subroutine
+end program
prs.context: Only this new standalone test and this leaf registration are added. No RUN macro, existing fixture, option or existing label changes. Fixed, tiny memory use and no files or modules.
prs.verified_evidence: Inspected runs pass on current main in default, --fast, --std=f23 and GFortran. Before the earlier landed compiler fix the same test fails with an ASR kind mismatch. The source is valid standard Fortran and the expected value follows from the declared array extent.
